text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So, apparently there's this concept called 
'parallel universes'! I just thought it'd 
be so fascinating if they really existed!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The other me in some other world... Does 
she love music as well, I wonder? What 
kind of sounds is she playing, I 
wonder...!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if only we could perform an ensemble 
together! Even if it's an impossible wish, 
I can't help but dream!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo... That's your 
sound. Even in "DAZT", we were 
"communicating". ...Maybe we can, 
"co-star".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Could those be footsteps!? If there's 
a chance we might co-star, does that mean 
there's a chance I might actually meet 
her?!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! The other me out there somewhere! 
Those thunderous footsteps... Could you be 
in the middle of a race?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san, do you hear anything else? 
Like, am I saying something...?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Doo-doo-doo-doo... "NIQU", the sound is 
"just that". Sounds of Earth's unique, 
"only one", even in "DIFF".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Is that all...? Just the sound of 
running... Ah! You mean quiet, as in a 
woman of few words? The other me!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A wordless passion playing its melody...! 
Splendid! Isn't it wonderful! It makes me 
want to perform together with you even 
more!
